# Your Daily Briefing – 20 January 2026

Yesterday was a solid effort — 12.9km in 75 minutes with an average HR of 160bpm shows you were working hard, and hitting 20,586 steps confirms you stayed active all day. Your body burned 3,832 kcal against a 2,300 target, so you're in a meaningful deficit. Good progress toward that 80-85kg goal.

Recovery looks mixed. HRV at 93ms sits below your 99-118ms baseline, which tells us yesterday's run left a real mark. Your resting HR of 50bpm and stress score of 34 are reassuring, but that HRV dip is worth respecting. Keep today's session easy — think Zone 2, conversational pace — rather than pushing intensity.

You burned nearly 1,500 kcal more than you ate yesterday, so prioritise protein today. Hit that 175g target early and consider adding a carbohydrate source post-run to support glycogen recovery and protect your sleep quality tonight. Six hours isn't enough — aim for seven.
